ja228:1.1: Three inside of the mountain I desire,
ja228:1.3: More than that, brahmin, I desire (that you)
ja228:1.4: Cure me, brahmin, one guided by desire.
ja228:2.1: Some there are who can work the bite of the cobras,
ja228:2.2: The wise can work possession by Amanussa.
ja228:2.3: But no one can work one who is led by desire,
ja228:2.4: What cure is there for one fallen from purity?
